title: Agentic software engineering
description: Agentic software engineering taught as a discipline, not a tool. The course teaches how to build good software by directing AI agents, and it measures good against industry standards: software that is functionally suitable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and fit for the person who uses it.
From module 6 to the end, you build one running project and carry it from a rough intent to a finished system.
